title: My Doorbell Camera Showed Someone Standing There for 6 Hours #shorts #horror
description: The doorbell camera caught someone on my porch all night. They never moved. They never rang. #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

hook.text: Someone stood at my door for six hours.

lines.text: I put a doorbell camera on my new house.
Next morning, I checked the overnight recording.
At midnight, someone walked up and stood on my porch.
No knock. No ring. They just stood there.
Six hours, facing the door, never moving.
At dawn, they turned and looked into the camera.
It was me. In the clothes I'd slept in.
That night, I locked my bedroom door and stayed awake.
At midnight, my phone buzzed. Motion at the front door.
Then a soft knock. From inside my bedroom.
